label: sdc02_0088_sister_01
text: So yeah, things are a bit rough right now...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_steelbb_01
text: I couldn’t agree more.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc02_0088_steelbb_02
text: Ah. You have a visitor, Carmine.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_02
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Long time no see, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!
I
bet
you
missed
me,
huh?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_03
text: Hehe... Honesty is the best policy, eh?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_04
text: What?! Did your wonderful memories of me\nall wither away since we last saw each other?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_steelbb_03
text: Time for me to go.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc02_0088_steelbb_04
text: Nice seeing you, Carmine. So long.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_05
text: Ah—OK, see you round![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_06
text: That’s one of my classmates. She’s an interesting\none![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_07
text: Hm. Speaking of classmates...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_08
text: It feels kinda weird seeing you here at my school.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_09
text: And look at you! You haven’t changed at all\nsince we last met![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_10
text: As for me, well, I’ve been helping Ms. Briar\nwith her research. We’ve been to all sorts of\r\ndifferent regions![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_11
text: It’s made my Pokémon a lot stronger than they\nwere the last time we battled![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_12
text:
Ehehe, you wanna see? Oh, you totally wanna
see.\c
Well, we have a battle court right here, so...
Get into position![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_13
text: OK, you ready for a Double Battle? You won’t\nknow what hit you![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_14
text: Agh! I got so much stronger once I could\nTerastallize my Pokémon, but you just had\r\nto go and get even stronger, didn’t you?![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_15
text: You still don’t hold back in battles, huh? Another\nthing that hasn’t changed a bit...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_16
text: Hey, by the way...have you, uh, run into Kiki yet?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_select_01
text: No, I haven’t

label: sdc02_0088_select_02
text: Something happen?

label: sdc02_0088_sister_17
text: Oh, never mind... If you haven’t seen him yet,\nit’s fine.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_brother_01
text: Are you kidding me?! What, was this assignment\ntoo hard for you too?[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_26
text: Wait, that’s—[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_27
text: I knew it! That’s Kieran. Phew, he almost saw us...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_select_05
text: Wait, that’s Kieran?!

label: sdc02_0088_select_06
text: He looks different!

label: sdc02_0088_sister_28
text: Shhh! Keep your voice down![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_brother_02
text: I thought I told you to train five Pokémon to\nbattle with.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0088_mob_01
text: S-sorry... Things have been really hectic at home\nthis month...

label: sdc02_0088_brother_03
text: Oh. Got it.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0088_brother_04
text: So that means you’re just OK being this weak\nforever? That what I’m hearing?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0088_mob_02
text: N-no, I—

label: sdc02_0088_brother_05
text: Well, since you’re so busy, I’ll go ahead and do\nyou a favor.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0088_brother_06
text: I’ll write your resignation from the club for you.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0088_brother_07
text: I don’t need people in my club who don’t take\nit seriously.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc02_0088_mob_03
text: W-wait, Kieran! I’m sorry! Give me another\nchance!

label: sdc02_0088_sister_29
text: ...Not what you were expecting, right?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_30
text: Kiki looks different, acts different...\c\nHe hasn’t been the same since we got back from\nthe school trip...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_01
text: Well, that was painful to watch.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_02
text: If it isn’t Carmine! And...Carmine’s new mystery\nfriend![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_03
text: Think I might’ve heard of you, though... Are you\nthat new kid with the wild backstory?[VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_18
text: What a lovely surprise! Just the annoying bozo\nI didn’t want to run into.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_04
text: C’mon, now. At least introduce me![VAR 0x0114(002C)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_19
text: This is Drayton...and he’s the worst.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_20
text: He’s the strongest Trainer at Blueberry Academy.\nWell, he WAS, at least.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_05
text: Beautiful intro. Thanks.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

text:

label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_06
text: What about Kieran? You friends with the guy?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0088_select_03
text: That’s right!

label: sdc02_0088_select_04
text: Yeah, we’re friends

label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_07
text: Ohoho, I see. That’s great![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

text:

How
about
I
show
you
our
clubroom?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_22
text: Huh? Why do you need to do that?![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_09
text: You haven’t joined any of the clubs we’ve got\nhere, right?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_10
text: Take it from me—you’ll have a way better time\nhere if you join one.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_11
text: We’d love to have such an interesting new\nmember! In fact, we better call dibs now.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0088_dragonbb_12
text: Come with me.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_23
text: Hey! Hold on![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_24
text: Gah! See? I told you he was the worst! Look at\nhim, just assuming we’ll go along with whatever![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc02_0088_sister_25
text: I’m going with you.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]
